artworkAdaptations: Character: cover unused baked slots, old right-hand wells and bottom wells with matching texture before drawing new cells and labels; never keep decorative hit areas.
Inventory: use adapted 7x7 asset, repaint unsupported currency and sort labels; retain existing three action buttons, gold pickup and weight only.

Command area: bottom-align the native shell; use relative screenshot placements for the compact wheel, normal-frame alpha, explicit back-to-front order and exclusive command centres. These are adapted coordinates, not measured original hit polygons; unsupported horse/exit icons remain unbound.
Chat: preserve existing text rendering; apply a thin official-style frame around the existing history viewport and separate input.
Minimap: preserve original map calculations and pan behavior, use explicit viewport. Zoom artwork is not a new zoom action.
remainingAcceptance: Freeze artwork and complete source manifest before enabling runtime bindings.
Measure text and preview clipping with actual client controls, including long names and large signed values.
Implement viewport/tab overflow and all lifecycle bindings; hidden-window geometry tests do not prove IME.
Verify unchanged NPC/service/storage combinations, gameplay actions, event counts and packets in the client.
